notes.title: PICROSS mode and new levels are out!
notes.content:
New "PICROSS" game mode is out today!
It also comes with 20 new levels!
AND night mode! Yaaay!

[url=https://youtu.be/ma2n9GVR3iQ]Watch trailer on YouTube[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32236321/819048437f81afa83d93934611c4552d76a8cb0c.png[/img]

INFO FOR OLD PLAYERS: new chapter is a third one. I moved third chapter forward so new players will unlock "picross" mode earlier.
